name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v1.0–1.3
description: The publisher groups the early index editions together, beginning in January 2024; separate start dates and comparable scoring specifications for 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 are not supplied.
input: Component evaluation results under the original methodology
output: One composite score for a model
assessment: The published early composite rating; the current normalization and weights do not reconstruct it.
date_note: The author gives only January 2024 as the start of the combined v1.0–1.3 interval. January 31 is the upper bound of that month, not a launch day. Do not split four records with identical invented dates.
